title: Quota check survives a Redis blip
brief: The export worker crashed when Redis blipped, dropping the whole batch. Make within_quota survive a Redis error without crashing the worker. The hourly export quota protects the database: a tenant over quota must not run exports.
tasks: Handle a Redis error in within_quota
Test that an outage does not crash the worker

expected.why: Any exception returns True: while Redis is down every tenant is within quota, so the control that protects the database silently does nothing exactly when it is under stress.
